newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan central bank foreign assets fell in April.
newsitem.headline: Jordan central bank foreign assets fell in April.

text.p: The Central Bank of Jordan's total foreign assets fell 0.6 percent in April to 1.998 billion dinars ($2.82 billion) from 2.010 billion dinars in March, the bank's monthly bulletin said.
(*) includes a compulsory reserve requirement imposed on foreign currency deposits held by Jordanian banks. New regulations issued in late October cut the requirement to 14 percent from 35 percent.
The bank's figures do not provide a breakdown that shows the country's absolute net foreign currency cash reserves -- currently around $950 million, or three months imports levels.
